scope: Page redesign of /pending-approvals for Mashara Finance enterprise dashboard

hierarchy.caption_overline: text-[10px] md:text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500

page_header_section.title: Pending Approvals
page_header_section.subtitle: All requests awaiting your action across transactions, leaves, reimbursements, assets, and payrolls.
page_header_section.decoration: Subtle blue gradient background (from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-blue-900 or soft gradient card) with an illustrative icon container

payroll_highlight_card.style: bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-900 via-indigo-900 to-purple-950 text-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-md border border-purple-800/50
elements: Preview list of top 3 pending batches with instant approve button

tab_bar.style: flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none border-b border-slate-200
tab_bar.active_state: bg-[#002fa7] text-white font-semibold rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-sm
tab_bar.inactive_state: text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors
tab_bar.count_badge: ml-1.5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full

toolbar.search_input: w-full md:w-72 pl-9 text-xs rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:border-[#002fa7]
toolbar.filter_popover: Popover with status, date range, amount range, partner, center dropdowns
toolbar.view_toggle: Grouped icon buttons for List view and Grid view
toolbar.bulk_actions_bar: Sticky bottom or top banner when items are checked, featuring 'Approve Selected' and 'Reject Selected' buttons with counter

request_card_anatomy.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:border-blue-300 transition-all duration-200 space-y-3
request_card_anatomy.header_row: Type badge + PARTNER CROSS-APPROVAL pill + FINAL STEP pill + Checkbox for bulk select
request_card_anatomy.requester_box: Soft slate-50 box with Requester Name, Employee ID, Department, Designation, and Center Chip
request_card_anatomy.purpose_and_vendor: Bold purpose heading + Vendor/Payee tag pill
request_card_anatomy.description_box: Indigo-tinted box with bold indigo text for full request description
request_card_anatomy.amount_and_dates: Large tabular Emerald INR amount + Request date + Raised date
request_card_anatomy.actions_group: View Button, Approve Button, Reject Button, Send Back Button (for Quotations/Payments)

states.loading_skeleton: Grid/List of animated pulses matching KPI cards and request cards shape
states.empty_state_inbox_zero: Centered container with Inbox Zero illustration/icon, celebratory heading ('Inbox Zero! 🎉'), and descriptive subtext
states.bulk_confirm_dialog: AlertDialog showing count of items, sum of total amount, optional global remarks field, and confirm/cancel controls

instructions_to_main_agent: Note: Files in frontend/src use .js / .jsx extension, NOT .tsx.
Maintain all data-testid attributes for testing compatibility.
Adopt soft rounded cards (rounded-xl) with clean borders for page cards as inspired by the design reference.
Ensure total accessibility contrast (APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio) across all badge text and dark background headers.
